name: icash_sms_inbound_campaign_current(uuid)
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_sms_inbound_campaign_current(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select public.icash_outreach_choice_current(p_account,'sms_inbound') or exists(
 select 1 from public.icash_outreach_campaigns c join public.icash_campaign_acknowledgments x on x.id=c.acknowledgment_id and x.account_id=c.account_id
 join public.icash_accounts a on a.id=c.account_id and a.owner_user_id=x.user_id
 where c.account_id=p_account and c.channel_selection_id is null and c.enabled and c.mode='sms_inbound' and x.policy_version='sms-inbound-2026-09-30.1'
 and exists(select 1 from public.icash_customer_identities i where i.account_id=c.account_id and length(trim(i.principal))>0 and i.principal=c.reviewed_principal))
$function$

name: icash_membership_work_allowed(uuid)
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_membership_work_allowed(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.icash_accounts a where a.id=p_account and (a.billing_model<>'membership_credits' or exists(select 1 from public.icash_memberships m where m.account_id=a.id and m.mode='live' and m.state='active' and m.paid_through>now())))
$function$

name: icash_conversation_street(text)
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_conversation_street(p_address text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select trim(split_part(p_address,',',1))||case
  when trim(split_part(p_address,',',2)) ~* '^(apt\.?|apartment|unit|suite|ste\.?|#)[[:space:]]*[[:alnum:]-]+$'
  then ' '||trim(split_part(p_address,',',2)) else '' end;
$function$

name: icash_sms_thread_review_current(uuid,uuid,boolean)
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_sms_thread_review_current(p_account uuid, p_thread uuid, p_check_hour boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if p_check_hour is null or public.icash_sms_review_before_business_hours(p_account,p_thread,false) is distinct from true then return false;end if;
 return not p_check_hour or public.icash_sms_outreach_window_current(p_account,p_thread);
end $function$

name: icash_seller_cash_question(text,text)
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_seller_cash_question(p_variant text, p_address text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare body text;begin
 if nullif(trim(p_address),'') is null then return null;end if;
 body:=case p_variant when 'cash_sale_v6' then 'Hi, have you considered a cash sale for '||trim(p_address)||'?'
 when 'all_cash_v6' then 'Hi, would you consider selling '||trim(p_address)||' for all cash?'
 when 'cash_offer_v6' then 'Hi, would you be open to a cash offer for '||trim(p_address)||'?' end;
 if length(body)>160 or body ~ '[^A-Za-z0-9 .,!?&#/-]' then return null;end if;return body;
end $function$
